title: The Road to Success® Magazine 2022, Issue 2
summary: In The Road to Success Magazine read how automated workflow technology is boosting agency productivity and a rookie agent found success selling Landstar capacity.
body_markdown:
If you've been to a concert recently, there's a good chance a Landstar trailer was parked behind the venue. Find out how Landstar is helping *many* shows to go on around the country in this issue of *The Road to Success®* magazine.


### Plus...


- How automated workflow technology is boosting agency productivity and enhancing communication
- How a rookie agent found success selling Landstar capacity
- How a second-generation safety award winner is carrying on her mother’s legacy
- How independent business owners in the Landstar network are finding success
